body.def: \(P_{v,b}^0\) is the closed rational set of all \(u\in\mathbb R^d\) satisfying the weak active tangent inequalities selected by \(b\), after frozen nonzero base signs and fixed ties have been resolved, together with the affine tangent assertion inequalities for semantic pattern \(v\). Empty systems are discarded by exact rational feasibility, and every equality face is included in every incident cell.
